steps.note: Open the single-stage auction creation flow, which is the closest supported path to the requested event.
Configure the closest supported auction strategy; sealed bid is not available in the catalog.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the requested product and quantity where the catalog supports them.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required by the auction create flow.
Invite three QA vendors, matching the requested Vendor A, B, and C audience without inventing vendor names.
Publish the closest supported auction so bids can be entered.
Verify that the event reached a real published project page.
Submit the first vendor bid at 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify that the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a second vendor bid at 95 through the next available vendor portal session.
Verify that the second vendor bid was accepted.
Verify on the buyer side that both submitted vendor responses are visible.
